title: The Selmer converse for elliptic curves at every prime
sections_read: README版本说明、actual main、全部preamble；introduction的精确主张、历史与证明roadmap图的节点/箭头/图注。
Arithmetic reduction：full p-power Selmer与compact rational Selmer；2-converse和analytic twist density外部输入；D,D′/K,F,L选择、root signs、两条Selmer line和Heegner reduction；全部character、valuation和measure约定。

Tame deformation：base Greenberg空间、controlled tame primes、每个序列上的admissible bounded cochains、specialization与t-division、cup-primitive修正、Heisenberg commutator obstruction、exact Artin length≤2、uniform local logarithm、weighted Heegner traces的1或3阶消失。

Holomorphic theta family：Hermitian/skew-Hermitian spaces、Fock权(m,m,1;−1)、literal monomial-dual/divided-power integral lattice、split p/q pivot tests、两个U算子、uniform unary moments的完整Igusa square/saturation证明和mixed Fourier–Jacobi integrality。

Constant terms：binary scalar multiplicity、raw toric periods、inverse Katz primitive与任意reduction的abelian log比较；Rallis/Waldspurger bilinear square比较、matrix/toric functional equations、p-factor与q原始Gauss/Euler因子的清分母、archimedean factorial cancellation、全cusp projected test控制、fixed Artin inverse与square-root coefficient induction。

Positive Fourier–Jacobi coefficient：norm-one orbit unfolding、两个unary characters分别的root sign、外部characteristic-zero simultaneous nonvanishing、compatible degree discs、moving unit-cut Euler factors避零；fixed-place spanning、bounded-denominator replacements和final binary Hecke controls。

Cusp lifting：actual J-level的canonical ordinary branch、finite étale boundary covers、positive coefficient base change、same dual-Fock functor、Hasse延拓与升权、Serre–Tate root trace normalization、augmentation content cancellation及full Artin Hecke-order factorization。

Characteristic-zero parameters：Labesse单一simultaneous transfer、逐real-factor holomorphic discrete-series sign、Arthur-block convention、parity-corrected algebraicity、RACSD Galois input、实际direct-sum表示、two Hodge–Newton contacts、binary separation resultants与actual inertia、Steinberg rank控制、uniform nilpotent annihilation。

Extension extraction：uniform module generators、ultraproduct/localization/henselization、faithful reduced ambient matrix algebra、2+1+1 corners、finite-value admissibility、corner determinant identities、cyclotomic corner elimination、no stable y-line的weight-sum contradiction、Fitting zero与full-Artin Greenberg lower bound≥b。
Sylvester application：paired 3-isogeny descents保留Sha terms从而得到full Selmer corank≤1，root sign选择rank one与rational cube sum。

Appendix全484行：isogenous global tori的normalized centralizer factor与degree lattice correction、coroot covolumes、common definable matching base、compatible differential-form measures、discriminant removal、finite stable recursion及change-of-characteristic transfer。全部1070行bibliography，含各引用版本/locator。
claim_as_stated: 对任意椭圆曲线A₀/ℚ、任意素数p及r∈{0,1}，若带全部局部Kummer条件的full p-power Selmer群的ℤp-corank为r，则ord_{s=1}L(A₀,s)=rankℤA₀(ℚ)=r，且整个Tate–Shafarevich群有限；不限制reduction、CM、残余表示、rational torsion或isogeny。应用：每个素数ℓ≡4,7,8 mod 9的X³+Y³=ℓZ³都有analytic/Mordell–Weil rank one、有限Sha，因而ℓ是两个有理立方之和。主张不包括refined BSD leading coefficient。
proof_architecture: 稿件将p=2交给同collection的外部2-converse；奇p以外部analytic twist-density的zero-density exceptional set在positive-density congruence classes中选D,D′。K imaginary、F real、L biquadratic CM且L/F所有finite places unramified、p全split、无额外根单位并排除A₀的CM field。parity给原曲线root sign，三条低analytic-rank twists经Gross–Zagier–Kolyvagin得到两条K-Selmer line；证明conductor-one Heegner trace y非torsion即可。

在任意reduction的p-adic Tate representation V上，local Kummer line自正交，H¹ local为hyperbolic plane，away-p rational local cohomology为零。Poitou–Tate与conjugation使one-sided Greenberg base group在nonzero-localization情形为零；唯一strict情形是r=1且Selmer line a处处局部零，Greenberg base为〈a,h〉、相反condition为〈a,hᶜ〉。辅助twist summand始终为零。

选split moving primes qᵢ和ring-class cyclic p-quotients ℓᵢ，nᵢ→∞，ℓᵢᶜ=−ℓᵢ、在固定S局部为零，vₚ(qᵢ−1)−nᵢ有界，p-adic ring-class local degrees的p-part有界。Frobenius趋γ，ε(γ)=1、det(V(γ)−1)≠0、C(γ)非root of unity且γ杀固定S-unit radicals。Lie quotient separation和Chebotarev用于同时满足条件。

将(1+t)^ℓᵢ在固定b截断并以p-adic ultralimit定义ψ∈R_b=k[t]/tᵇ。admissible cochains必须有单一uniform denominator，且identity在每个Galois-element sequence成立，等价uniform increasing precision。specialization回到固定Galois cohomology，t coefficient sequence在cochain level精确，local zero/Kummer conditions可bounded correction后除以t。

strict时first-order lift需δx′=−ηℓᵢ∪x。以opposite local class d、δu=x∪d构造Hγ的corrected primitive。global reciprocity使任何lift的Hγ(x,d)=0。在V-kernel上的独立translations a,d⁻生成Heisenberg commutator σ，u(σ)≠0而V、C、ε及S-unit radicals在σ上不变；改γ→γσᵐ可使Hγ在两组base中成为[[0,κ],[−κ,0]]、κ≠0。故无非零base class能lift到order two。exact Selmer-cone sequence迭代将全部高阶cohomology挤到最后t-layer，length≤2且t杀之；non-strict始终length 0。取b*=3或1。

y torsion使raw weighted Heegner Kummer trace的augmentation=(a_q−2)y为零。strict时第一次除t的specialization在conjugation下anti-invariant却Selmer line invariant，故零；再除t所得base line处处local zero。借bounded p-part的unramified local degree和uniform Néron/formal logarithm估计，weighted local Heegner logs在t^{b*}前系数均趋零，高阶固定截断仍有下valuation界。

构造source compact U(2)、target两个real places均U(3,1)的holomorphic theta。Fock minors给(m,m,1;−1)，系数用Γ^{m−1}(∧²H)的literal dual monomial lattice；split pivot tests在p给U₂=U₃=p²，q使用full compact equivariance抵消varying character，避免除以ring-class order。unary moments先逐scalar group coefficient建立square的common Igusa ring、compatible cusp expansion norm与least-denominator saturation，再取scalar平方根成bounded position measure；mixed expansions继承uniform denominators。

constant coefficient是binary lift的共同scalar S。multiplicity-one论证与local intertwiners将其平方同两个raw toric periods P₀²P₁²比较；p处两个functional equations的gamma orientation相同而完全抵消，q处保留完整raw Gauss/Euler factor并先在group algebra清分母。P₀的inverse Katz derivative经共同primitive/path integration等于Heegner logs，包含bad reduction。augmentation非零且valuation有界的clearing factor在固定Artin ring有bounded inverse；从S²在t^{2b*}前趋零及所有系数bounded，用偶次系数归纳得S在t^{b*}前趋零。

另用norm-one positive Fourier–Jacobi orbit、固定非零stabilizer period与两个unary periods给非constant coefficient的augmentation valuation上界。两条unary root signs分别为+1，外部characteristic-zero nonvanishing选固定finite characters；在d₁+d₂=−1的compatible discs同时避开两个period及moving Euler factors的零点。fixed-place local spanning用非零minor/Cramer rule得到bounded replacement，保留p/q tests及所需binary/Steinberg controls。

target ordinary PEL几何独立于A₀ reduction。actual J-level的canonical branch仅给multiplicative flag/frame及finite étale boundary covers；同一integral divided-power bundle的positive Jacobi coefficients经ample abelian vanishing/base change lifting。Hasse powers在ordinary frames为1，升到λ′=(m+H,m+H,1+H;−1−H)后由Serre vanishing lift成genuine cusp forms。Serre–Tate root trace给integral normalized U₂,U₃且comparison value均1。nonconstant augmentation content用固定bC precision loss取消任意Hecke polynomial relation，得到full Artin ring的Hecke-order map。

Labesse transfer通过每个real factor的individual holomorphic pseudocoefficient sign property产生同一Arthur parameter，保持full infinitesimal character与所有split finite local data。将cuspidal factors作parity-corrected regular algebraic conjugate-self-dual twists后用外部Galois输入，再按Arthur shifted copies作实际direct sum，得4维ρᶜ≅ρ∨ε⁻³与Hodge weights。两个unit operators给Hodge–Newton contacts和2⊂3⊂4 flags；binary resultants排除head/final linkages，direct-sum structure补足monodromy domination，得到actual inertia identity；(3,1) parahoric给Steinberg inertia rank≤1。bounded local allocation filtrations使Hecke nilpotents被固定power resultant杀死，precision只损固定常数。

用uniform pro-p generators、degree-eight matrix PI与Shirshov height将Bᵢ=Tᵢ[ρᵢ]压成uniformly finite module generators。ultraproduct/localization/henselization构造finite T-algebra B及faithful reduced ambient ring，limiting trace分成f=V(−2)ψ±、x=ε⁻¹、y=ε⁻²，lift rank-one idempotents并得到2+1+1 corner modules。finite-value admissibility把任意B→M₄(R_b) map还原为bounded finite-stage cochains；local rank conditions改写为corner determinant identities以在quotient中存活。

先将D_xy/(D_xfD_fy)的dual注入cyclotomic H¹，并以p-local splitting、binary/Steinberg inertia和CM biquadratic unit-rank-one local-log injectivity证明它为零，得D_xy=D_xfD_fy。若D_fy在任一ambient field为零，则y-line globally stable；actual algebraic rank-one constituent由unitary bounds有conjugate weight sum3，而residual y=ε⁻²有sum4，在同一固定local unit pair上形成不可消失unit矛盾。故D_fy每个field非零，annihilator/Fitt₀为零。

对M=D_fy⊗R_b取dual，crossing cycle和D_xy factorization确保三角algebra map；common-kernel corner minors在整个Artin ring上给conjugate p-place split，得到Hom(M,R_b)↪同一admissible Greenberg module。Fitt₀(M)=0及R_b elementary divisors给dual length≥b，与upper bound0<1或≤2<3矛盾，故y非torsion并结束主张。Sylvester应用用成对3-isogeny descent的Sha kernels a,b相消得到s₃≤(1−a−b)+(a+b)=1，再由root sign−1取rank1。

独立appendix计算isogenous tori必须比较的组合cη(T)/|π₀(T̂^Γ)|，其中function-field degree index I(T)不可遗漏；split degree-one place使I=1。随后把fixed nonstandard weighted orbital-integral pairs放在同一definable root-data/outer-action/regular-parameter space，选compatible Lie differential frames，清ambient volumes和共同Levi square-root discriminant，再以constructible function零性作change-of-characteristic transfer。正文的Labesse simple trace-formula route明确不使用weighted fundamental lemma。

construction_ideas.idea: 保留整个nilpotent Artin parameter，用length比较记录在specialization中消失的信息。
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: 固定R_b=k[t]/tᵇ；bounded finite-stage cochain identities须在每个argument sequence成立；coefficient reduction/t multiplication给exact complexes且local conditions可bounded division。若base维数d且所有非零base class的order-two lift受nondegenerate obstruction排除，则高阶H¹被t杀、length≤d。另一个构造必须映入这个同一module并给length≥b>d。
construction_ideas.mechanism: 稿件选择b=3以超过strict base维数2，first-order obstruction与exact coefficient sequence把全部cohomology压至last layer；full-Artin Galois corner/Fitting计算则保留至少b的长度。单看t=0或各character specialization不足以区分两边。
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: 对π项目，试把Q(Z)的row-transversal rank和quadratic occupancy约束编码进一个固定阶t-family。可先测试候选minor在t-adic filtration中的leading coefficient和first-order obstruction，再比较一个统一integer determinant对象允许的vanishing order与构造强迫的order。更广是deformation/obstruction理论与离散rank persistence的接口。
construction_ideas.missing_step: 当前没有Q(Z)的exact Artin cochain/module模型，更没有同一个可清分母integer determinant的upper/lower length比较。rank over k(t)、finite character pointwise nonvanishing或某阶t coefficient非零都不能自动给所需integer determinant非零或解析smallness；height与quadratic occupancy必须重新定量证明。

construction_ideas.idea: 在full algebra先清分母，再固定阶截断；用augmentation内容统一控制逆和取消。
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: D_i(t)在固定tᵇ截断内所有coefficients valuation有共同下界，且constant coefficient非零、valuation有共同上界。有限stage group relation被替换后仅误差p^{n_i−c_b}，n_i→∞。若integral a(t)的vₚ(a(0))≤C，则a r∈pᴹR_b推出r∈p^{M−bC}R_b，独立于finite coefficient extension。
construction_ideas.mechanism: 以D⁻¹=d₀⁻¹∑_{j<b}(−d₀⁻¹(D−d₀))ʲ作有限幂级数，损失只依赖b和constant valuation。稿件在q处从完整raw factor H_q清Euler denominator，拒绝单独除q−1、Gauss sums或growing character projector；随后同一个bounded inverse处理constant terms和全部Hecke relations。
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: π的determinant/row operations若引入scale-dependent rational factors，可先在共同polynomial/group algebra保留清分母identity，再以某个augmentation minor提供bounded cancellation。它可作为height账本：将固定truncation损失与随dimension/column height增长的损失明确分开，也可迁移至p-adic interpolation及symbolic certificates。
construction_ideas.missing_step: π目标主要是Archimedean small integer determinant，本lemma只给p-adic precision而非real absolute value。必须找到同一个实际对象、证常数项的uniform valuation上界，并把局部逆损失与global denominator/height相乘；一般nonzero augmentation不保证Archimedean inverse小。

construction_ideas.idea: 用literal dual monomial/divided-power lattice避免在高次表示中偷偷引入factorial。
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: W finite locally free integral module；coefficient lattice定义为Γᵈ(W)=(Symᵈ(W∨))∨，与input polynomial monomials literal pairing1。所有frame changes和diagonal pullback均在此同一functor中记录；不得以rational Γᵈ≅Symᵈ替换而忽略factorials。
construction_ideas.mechanism: 稿件Fock input是Symᵈ((∧²H)∨)，theta coefficient array为其integral dual。monomial extraction不乘binomial/factorial；diag(c₁,c₂,c₃)在dual coefficient上的action为∏(c_ic_j)^{a_ij}。同一lattice贯穿theta estimates、Hasse cusp lifting及normalized trace，避免weight增长造成不可控denominator。
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: Q(Z)以derivatives、binomial coefficients、symmetric tensors或polynomial evaluation构行时，可先选整数valued/binomial或dual monomial basis并准确记录pairing。适当基可能把由高阶微分产生的factorial height从每列估计中移除，从而使column-height与quadratic occupancy账本更紧。此处接口是integral representation theory与integer determinant设计。

construction_ideas.idea: 把易在quotient后丢失的subspace信息先改写为corner minors的polynomial identities。
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: 一个finite algebra faithfully嵌入M_n(ℛ)，ℛ reduced且field evaluations检测零；有rank-one idempotents和相容matrix units。stacked local matrices有共同kernel/quotient；所选minor的row/column surplus只剩一条u←y path，其余为diagonal cycles。competing-column minor在residue非零从而在目标Artin ring为unit。
construction_ideas.mechanism: determinant每个monomial的directed graph分解成surplus path与cycles，故minor本身是intrinsic corner element。fieldwise common-kernel导致此element为零，algebra quotient后identity仍存活；再invert competing minor重建common eigenline，且覆盖nilpotent coefficients。
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: π项目可将一个有约束行列式的nonvanishing证书写成Plücker/minor identity，再研究在projection、row selection、column compression、quotient lattice后哪些identities和pivot units仍存活。对于row-transversal满秩，显式记录一个surviving pivot minor比只记录某个ambient rank更便于和column cost联用。更广泛是quiver/corner algebra与matroid certificates的接口。
construction_ideas.missing_step: Q(Z)尚无上述idempotent corner algebra或unit competing minor。fieldwise rank不保证integral primitive minor，quotient后可能全部nonzero minors被large index消去。必须给实际row-transversal、整数index与height预算；本方法只提示可审核证书的形式。

construction_ideas.idea: 用annihilator/Fitting ideal把每个field的非零对象提升为truncated ring的总length下界。
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: T↪ℛ faithful，ℛ reduced；finite T-module D在每个ambient field evaluation的image非零，故Ann_T(D)=0并有Fitt₀,T(D)=0。base change到R_b=k[t]/tᵇ，得到finite M；还需dual Hom_Rb(M,R_b)注入目标约束空间。
construction_ideas.mechanism: R_b上M=⊕R_b/(t^{a_j})，Fitt₀(M)=(t^{∑a_j})=0迫∑a_j≥b；R_b self-dual的每个cyclic summand与dual等长，故获得dual length≥b。它允许多个短torsion summands共同贡献，不要求直接找一个free rank-one summand。
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: 对带occupancy限制的row选择可尝试以cokernel/presentation module记录所有可用minor的ideal，用Fitting ideal将跨参数nonzero rank证书汇总，再同容量上界比较。可能的远接口是commutative algebra support与combinatorial matching/row-transversal obstruction，而非从单个generic rank跳到整数非零。
construction_ideas.missing_step: Fitt零不自动给某个指定minor非零，也不控制Archimedean size或integer lattice index。π项目需构造finite presentation对应Q(Z)的真正允许行、证明base-change后的约束兼容并取得定量minor，而不是仅generic support。

construction_ideas.idea: 在保持全部primary invariants不变的kernel里，用commutator只改变secondary obstruction。
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: 两独立cocycles a,d在representation kernel N_V上成为translations，joint image spans V⊕V；δu=a∪d且Weil pairing nondegenerate。commutator σ=[g,g′]在translations、V、所有one-dimensional characters和radical Kummer homomorphisms上为零，但u(σ)=−e(a(g),d(g′))+e(a(g′),d(g))可非零。

limits: 这是固定提交源码闭包的完整首读记录，不是独立数学证明核验、同行评议、Lean认证或对定理正确性的背书。未编译/逐页视觉对照PDF；PDF本身未读，源码全部已读。

正文明确把unrestricted 2-converse和analytic twist-density引用为外部established inputs，且引用同collection的另一稿件；本次没有回读或验证该稿件。Gross–Zagier–Kolyvagin、duality、theta/period formulas、PEL geometry、Labesse transfer、RACSD Galois input、BHTY nonvanishing等外部证明也均未核验。bibliography全读仅表示读了文献记录、版本和locator。
主张仅是full p-power Selmer corank 0或1的converse及Sha finiteness，不是任意rank BSD，也不计算refined leading coefficient。奇p construction使用p>2、p全split的辅助fields和character branches；不可将其tame-cochain或parity分解无条件套到p=2。

admissibility要求对每个元素序列的identity和uniformly bounded denominators；对固定Galois elements逐点成立、每个finite-order character分别成立或coefficient fields的非紧union都不足以替代。uniform finite-generator、local polynomial-identity和all-sequence arguments是重要接口，未独立重证。
strict case upper bound、Heegner log三阶消失和Galois lower bound必须使用同一reselected tame character及同一b*=3。first-order obstruction和log vanishing是不同论证；不能把其中之一当作另一个。

正文控制的是target PEL ordinary locus和两个normalized parabolic units，不要求椭圆曲线ordinary。local-global input仅monodromy domination，稿件另用actual direct-sum Arthur construction及allocation separation控制actual inertia；不能擅自将domination换成full local compatibility。

clearing factors的bounded inverse只在固定Artin truncation成立，不能推出full growing group ring有bounded inverse，亦不能除以growing character projectors或raw group order。literal monomial-dual lattice、measure conventions、root reciprocity方向都要持续一致。
